items.questionEn: What is the main purpose of SYS.1?

options.text: Validate the product in operational use

items.explanationVi: SYS.1 tập trung vào Requirements Elicitation: thu thập và xác định nhu cầu/yêu cầu từ stakeholder.

source.document: ASPICE – System Requirements, Architecture, Verification & Validation

items.questionEn: What is the key difference between a stakeholder need and a system requirement?

options.text: A stakeholder need describes what stakeholders want; a system requirement defines what the system shall do
A stakeholder need is always a software design; a system requirement is source code
A stakeholder need is a test result; a system requirement is a defect

items.explanationVi: Stakeholder need diễn đạt nhu cầu/kỳ vọng; system requirement chuyển nhu cầu đó thành yêu cầu kỹ thuật mà system phải thực hiện.

source.document: ASPICE – System Requirements, Architecture, Verification & Validation

items.questionEn: Which characteristic is important for a high-quality system requirement?

options.text: It must be ambiguous so developers can interpret it freely
It should be verifiable and traceable
It should be independent of stakeholder needs

items.explanationVi: Requirement chất lượng cần rõ ràng, đầy đủ, nhất quán, khả thi, có thể verify/test và trace được.

source.document: ASPICE – System Requirements, Architecture, Verification & Validation

items.questionEn: Which activity belongs to SYS.3?

options.text: Define system architecture, allocation, interfaces and behavior

items.explanationVi: SYS.3 là System Architectural Design, bao gồm architecture, allocation, interfaces, dynamic behavior và rationale.

source.document: ASPICE – System Requirements, Architecture, Verification & Validation

items.questionEn: What does bidirectional traceability allow a project to demonstrate?

options.text: Links can be followed both forward and backward across development artifacts

items.explanationVi: Bidirectional traceability cho phép trace xuôi và ngược giữa stakeholder, requirements, architecture, design, implementation và test.

source.document: ASPICE – System Requirements, Architecture, Verification & Validation

items.questionEn: What is an orphan requirement?

options.text: A requirement with no corresponding downstream design or implementation link
A requirement that has passed all tests
A requirement that is already baselined
A requirement that has a valid source

items.explanationVi: Orphan requirement là requirement không có liên kết tới design hoặc implementation phía sau.

source.document: ASPICE – System Requirements, Architecture, Verification & Validation

items.questionEn: What is the purpose of a baseline?

options.text: To provide a controlled and approved reference version of an artifact
To eliminate the need for requirements

items.explanationVi: Baseline là phiên bản artifact đã được review/kiểm soát và dùng làm reference chính thức cho các bước downstream.

source.document: ASPICE – System Requirements, Architecture, Verification & Validation

items.questionEn: What is the main purpose of SWE.1?
items.explanationVi: SWE.1 phân tích system requirements để xác định software requirements rõ ràng, khả thi, testable và traceable.

source.document: ASPICE – System Requirements, Architecture, Verification & Validation

items.questionEn: What is the main focus of SWE.2?
items.explanationVi: SWE.2 thiết kế software architecture, gồm component, interface, dependency, data/control flow và behavior.

source.document: ASPICE – System Requirements, Architecture, Verification & Validation

items.questionEn: Which sequence best represents the SWE.1–SWE.3 flow?

options.text: SW requirements → SW architecture → detailed design/unit/code
System qualification → SW architecture → stakeholder needs

items.explanationVi: Chuỗi SWE là: SWE.1 Software Requirements → SWE.2 Software Architecture → SWE.3 Detailed Design & Unit Construction.

source.document: ASPICE – System Requirements, Architecture, Verification & Validation

items.questionEn: What is the main difference between verification and validation?

options.text: Verification checks conformity to specification; validation checks suitability for intended use
Verification is only for hardware; validation is only for software
Verification replaces requirements; validation replaces architecture
They are exactly the same activity

items.explanationVi: Verification hỏi sản phẩm có làm đúng specification không; validation hỏi sản phẩm có phù hợp intended use và operational context không.

source.document: ASPICE – System Requirements, Architecture, Verification & Validation

items.questionEn: What does SWE.4 focus on?
items.explanationVi: SWE.4 là Software Unit Verification, kiểm tra unit có phù hợp với detailed design hay không.

source.document: ASPICE – System Requirements, Architecture, Verification & Validation

items.questionEn: What is the primary focus of SWE.5?

options.text: Software integration and interaction between software components

items.explanationVi: SWE.5 tập trung vào software integration, đặc biệt là interface và interaction giữa các software components.

source.document: ASPICE – System Requirements, Architecture, Verification & Validation

items.questionEn: What is the test basis for SWE.6?
items.explanationVi: SWE.6 là Software Qualification Test và sử dụng software requirements làm test basis.

source.document: ASPICE – System Requirements, Architecture, Verification & Validation

items.questionEn: What is the primary focus of SYS.4?
items.explanationVi: SYS.4 tích hợp các system elements và kiểm tra interface, interaction giữa chúng.

source.document: ASPICE – System Requirements, Architecture, Verification & Validation

items.questionEn: What is the test basis for SYS.5?
items.explanationVi: SYS.5 là System Qualification Test và dùng system requirements làm test basis.

source.document: ASPICE – System Requirements, Architecture, Verification & Validation

items.questionEn: What does VAL.1 primarily demonstrate?

options.text: The product is suitable for its intended use and operational context
Every unit matches its detailed design
Every software interface is syntactically correct
All requirements are written by developers

items.explanationVi: VAL.1 chứng minh sản phẩm phù hợp với intended use trong operational context.

source.document: ASPICE – System Requirements, Architecture, Verification & Validation

items.questionEn: Which set best describes what a V&V strategy should define?

options.text: Objectives, criteria, test selection, coverage, environment and execution approach
Only developer names and project budget

items.explanationVi: V&V strategy cần xác định mục tiêu, criteria, lựa chọn test, coverage, environment và cách thực thi.

source.document: ASPICE – System Requirements, Architecture, Verification & Validation

items.questionEn: Which chain best represents traceable test evidence?
items.explanationVi: Evidence cần liên kết requirement với test, result và configuration đã được sử dụng khi test.

source.document: ASPICE – System Requirements, Architecture, Verification & Validation

items.questionEn: Why should the test configuration be recorded?

options.text: To identify exactly which software, hardware, environment and configuration were tested
To guarantee every future version will pass

items.explanationVi: Configuration giúp xác định chính xác version và environment của lần test, làm evidence có ý nghĩa và có thể truy lại.

source.document: ASPICE – System Requirements, Architecture, Verification & Validation

items.questionEn: What should happen when a verification test produces an unexpected result?

options.text: It should be recorded and managed as an anomaly for analysis and resolution
The requirement should automatically be removed

items.explanationVi: Kết quả bất thường cần được ghi nhận thành anomaly, phân tích, xử lý và kiểm soát resolution.

source.document: ASPICE – System Requirements, Architecture, Verification & Validation

items.questionEn: Why is regression testing performed after a change?

options.text: To check that existing functionality still works after the change
To remove all previous test results

items.explanationVi: Regression test kiểm tra chức năng đã có trước đó vẫn hoạt động sau khi sửa lỗi hoặc thay đổi.

source.document: ASPICE – System Requirements, Architecture, Verification & Validation

items.questionEn: What are test exit criteria?

options.text: Defined conditions that must be met before a test phase is considered complete
A list of developers who wrote the code

items.explanationVi: Exit criteria xác định điều kiện phải đạt trước khi kết thúc test phase, thay vì chỉ kết thúc vì hết thời gian.

source.document: ASPICE – System Requirements, Architecture, Verification & Validation

items.questionEn: Which sequence best summarizes the engineering flow from requirements to validation?
items.explanationVi: Luồng tổng quát: xác định requirements → thiết kế architecture → detailed design/code → verification → validation.

source.document: ASPICE – System Requirements, Architecture, Verification & Validation

items.questionEn: Which four keywords summarize the main project control flow?
items.explanationVi: Bốn từ khóa giúp nhớ checklist: trace mọi artifact, kiểm soát baseline, thực hiện test và lưu evidence.

source.document: ASPICE – System Requirements, Architecture, Verification & Validation
